dedupe_keys.name: utslapp i siffror swedish pollutant release and transfer register

description: Sweden's register of releases and waste from environmentally hazardous activities. The register page says it contains details of releases from some 1,300 facilities engaged in environmentally hazardous activities, and the search shows 1,337 facilities; users can filter by county, municipality, sector, activity, installation and substance, choose emissions or waste, and search in a map, with views of emissions to air and to water. The agency's page says the register is the Swedish implementation of the PRTR protocol under the Aarhus Convention, that larger industrial operations report under international rules, and that it holds data from point sources and smaller diffuse sources at several geographic levels. It is free to use online. Coverage is Sweden at facility level. Caveats: the licence, bulk download options and years covered are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it locates industrial facilities and their releases for exposure mapping and consequence modelling. A related catalogue record is the EU Industrial Emissions Portal.
